# IT-DT published results and figure index

**Everything indexed here is reported by Kreso et al.; nothing is a result generated by this project.** The paper remains a preprint. Its reported performance, timing and uncertainty have not been reproduced, and its protocol is not interchangeable with CAROTS or the ensemble's protocol.

Source: [arXiv:2603.01621v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.01621v1), [local PDF](artifacts/papers/IT_DT_arxiv_2603.01621v1.pdf). License: [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Retain this attribution and version when reusing published graphics or tables.

## Tables

| Source locator | Contents | What is available |
|---|---|---|
| Table I | SWaT/WADI precision, recall and F1 for PCA, USAD, GDN, TranAD and IT-DT | Full table in PDF/HTML and `artifacts/source/arxiv_v1/Manuscript.tex` |
| Table II | Detection-delay comparison for SWaT Attack #41 and reported uncertainty | Table presentation only; event scores, original delay observations and bootstrap outputs unavailable |
| Table III | CPU/GPU inference latency comparison | Table presentation only; original profiler/run logs unavailable |

For orientation, Table I reports the following **author-reported IT-DT values**, on a 0–1 scale:

| Dataset | Precision | Recall | F1 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| SWaT | 0.910 | 0.766 | 0.832 |
| WADI | 0.785 | 0.505 | 0.615 |

These are literature values, not target scores, verified outcomes or evidence that our pipeline works. Do not tune our method until it matches them.

Figure PDFs cannot substitute for those missing artifacts. Consult the [resource manifest](../RESOURCE_MANIFEST.json) for actual downloaded/extracted files and checksums, and [EXPERIMENTS.md](EXPERIMENTS.md) for limitations before interpreting a numerical comparison.
